mapper.insert: insert into t_demand_apply (demand_id, teacher_id, message, status, create_time) values (#{demandId}, #{teacherId}, #{message}, '0', sysdate())
mapper.select: select demand_id from t_demand_apply where teacher_id = #{teacherId}

select ap.apply_id, ap.demand_id, ap.teacher_id, ap.message, ap.status, ap.create_time, ap.update_time, d.title as demand_title, d.subjects as demand_subjects, d.grade as demand_grade, coalesce(a.nickname, concat(left(a.email, 3), '***')) as teacher_name, 'TEACHER' as teacher_role from t_demand_apply ap join t_student_demand d on d.demand_id = ap.demand_id and d.del_flag = '0' left join t_customer_account a on a.account_id = ap.teacher_id where d.student_id = #{studentId} order by ap.create_time desc, ap.apply_id desc
select count(*) from t_demand_apply where demand_id = #{demandId}
select apply_id from t_demand_apply where demand_id = #{demandId}
mapper.update: update t_demand_apply set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where apply_id = #{applyId}
